name: Navy Federal Credit Union (credit cards)
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public navyfederal.org pages only (no sign-in). Sign-in to digital banking uses username, password and two-step verification (the 4-digit app passcode was retired); online-banking enrollment sends a texted security code that must be entered within 6 minutes, so auth.mfa is 'sms'. The digitalomni sign-in page is script-rendered and could not be read; field labels are the family defaults. Paying: on the Accounts screen choose 'Make Payment' for the card and follow the prompts; payments from a Navy Federal account post the same day, from an external account in 2 to 5 days. Recurring payments: under Make Payment choose 'Recurring Monthly Payment' (the payments page says the Move Money tab); any day from the 1st to the 28th, and only when the card is not past due (the not-past-due rule is not modelled). Due date can be changed once every 6 months and may take up to 2 billing cycles (not modelled). The due date is 25 days after the billing cycle closes. Paperless: Statements > 'Paperless Delivery Preferences' (app: More > Account and Tax Statements); up to 36 months of statements are kept; the page describes Digital Banking accounts generally. Fees page: late payment $20.00, returned payment no charge. Closing: call 1-888-842-6328 any time, visit a branch, send a secure message or mail PO Box 3000, Merrifield, VA 22180; a closed card cannot be reopened and unredeemed rewards are forfeited (rewards terms). Member Services 1-888-842-6328, 24/7. Cancelling a recurring payment is not described on the cited pages (catalog research says Move Money or by phone); autopay_cancel stays at the family default. No pay-without-sign-in option (inferred).

guest_pay.note: Navy Federal card payments are made after you sign in to digital banking or the app. You can also call Member Services at 1-888-842-6328, 24/7.

autopay.note: Recurring payments can be set for any day from the 1st through the 28th, as long as your card is not past due.

cancel_service.note: To close your card, call 1-888-842-6328 any time, visit a branch, send us a secure message, or mail a letter to PO Box 3000, Merrifield, VA 22180.

help.title: Making credit card payments
paragraphs: Sign in to digital banking or the app. On your Accounts screen choose Make Payment for the card you want to pay and follow the steps on screen.

A payment from a Navy Federal account posts the same day. A payment from an account at another bank can take 2 to 5 days to post. You can also pay by phone through Member Services at 1-888-842-6328, 24/7.
steps: On the Accounts screen choose Make Payment for your card.
Follow the on-screen steps to finish.

help.title: Recurring monthly payments
paragraphs: Set up a recurring monthly payment in mobile or online banking: under Make Payment choose Recurring Monthly Payment (the Move Money tab also offers automatic payments).
Pick any day from the 1st through the 28th of the month. Recurring payments can be set up only while your card is not past due.

help.title: Your due date
paragraphs: You can change your credit card's due date once every 6 months; the change can take up to 2 billing cycles to take effect.

help.title: Paperless statements
paragraphs: Sign in and choose Statements from the menu (in the app tap More, then Account and Tax Statements). Select Paperless Delivery Preferences, choose your options and save.
Up to 36 months of statements are saved for you to view or print at any time.

help.title: Credit card payment fees
paragraphs: A late payment fee of $20.00 applies when the minimum payment is not made by the due date. There is no charge for a returned payment.

help.title: Closing an account
paragraphs: To close an account, visit a branch, send a secure message, call 1-888-842-6328 or mail a letter to PO Box 3000, Merrifield, VA 22180.
